description:
Make storage's pinned target inspection run on a git module checkout and replace its test-only program path with an injectable `Git`.

## Background

- `JsonFileStorage::inspect_pinned_targets` (`crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:490-504`) builds a `GitRevisionResolver` from `git_program` (`crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:403`, default `:441`), which only `#[cfg(test)] with_git_program` (`crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:481-488`) sets.
- That constructor's callers are the storage capture tests at `crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs:2657`, `:2695`, `:2744` and `:2772`, which pass the shared counting stand-in.
- Its signature returns `Result<PinnedTargetRead, GitRevisionError>` (`crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:496`), naming the bridge's error alias.
- `GitRevisionResolver` is a bridge over `GitCheckout`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `JsonFileStorage` holds a `Git` in place of `git_program`, its test-only constructor takes a `Git`, and pinned inspection calls `GitCheckout::inspect_pinned_targets` on a checkout of that `Git` at the requested worktree root, without the bridge; its signature names the module's error type, not `GitRevisionError`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The four capture tests construct storage with a `Git` naming the stand-in and keep their process counts and subcommands.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Storage pinned inspection runs on a module checkout
